# Orlando Magic 2026/27 NBA Season Preview

Locked On Fantasy Basketball, 2026-08-01, 37:55. https://youtu.be/FEcNjVRlj-U

## Summary

Josh Lloyd and Philip Rossman-Reich (Locked On Magic) preview Orlando's 2026/27 season. The Magic won 45 games last year despite a lot of random injuries. The roster is mostly unchanged: Nikola Vucevic replaces Mo Wagner as backup center, and Sean Sweeney replaces Jamahl Mosley as coach. The projected starting five is Jalen Suggs, Desmond Bane, Franz Wagner, Paolo Banchero and Wendell Carter Jr. Anthony Black is expected to be the sixth man and main bench creator. Phil worries more about Suggs's injury risk than Franz Wagner's because Suggs's injuries come from his all-out style of play, and he sees Suggs as a likely trade candidate because Black will need a big contract. Phil predicts 47 or 48 wins and the 6th seed.

## Rules and methods

- [17:46](https://youtu.be/FEcNjVRlj-U?t=1066) Injuries that come from a player's style of play are more likely to happen again than random contact injuries. Expect more missed games from players who play all out.
  > "I I think it's Jaylen Suggs. Um just the way that Jaylen plays, he doesn't know how to turn it off."
- [8:33](https://youtu.be/FEcNjVRlj-U?t=513) A backup center can get extra minutes on nights when the starter is in foul trouble, injured or not scoring.
  > "there'll definitely be nights where where Vu plays more because Carter's in foul trouble or Carter's hurt"
